r2_scope.name: header_crc timing fix
r2_scope.content: In a1_uart_export.v, precompute crc_fin at hdr_idx==39 (~crc32b(crc_r,hdr_byte)) so the header CRC word at byte 40 uses the updated value. No other header logic change. Verify header_crc=true.

r2_scope.name: 8x2 reference/crop diagnostic (must for 0 mismatch)
r2_scope.content: Run CAM 32x4, ROI (4,2), W=8, H=2; print DUT raw first 16 B and reference first 16 B plus (y,x) mapping. Decide: (a) tools/a1/a1_pattern.py roi_samples x0/row convention, or (b) a1_raw_crop eff_line/eff_grp off-by-one. If (a), fix reference/verify only. If (b), fix only the one crop line and record it. If neither explains the 2,077,900 B mismatch or it needs core/frame changes, stop BLOCKED.

r2_scope.name: MODE=2 fault semantics
r2_scope.content: Fix TB phase timing (not RTL) so the fault run actually exercises: bad frame (short line) -> geom/raw_drop increment and no publish; reset mid-frame -> no publish; recovery -> publish; three quick frames -> overflow drop without corruption; backpressure AW_GAP/R_GAP. Capture bytes; no half-frame. If a DUT bug remains, stop and report.

r2_scope.name: MODE=1 full or shortened + 2,594,706 B max-length unit test
r2_scope.content: Run MODE=1 full 1920x1080 incompressible if time; otherwise run a shortened incompressible frame plus a store/export max-length unit test at 2,594,706 B. Write evidence_boundary=shortened_geometry if shortened; per-sample 0 mismatch only for samples actually run; never call it a full frame.

r2_scope.name: Full 1080p rerun + verify/freeze
r2_scope.content: Rerun MODE=0 full 1920x1080 with the fixed RTL; verify header_crc=true, all four CRCs true, per-sample 0 mismatch, raw_len 2,592,000, stream_len <=2,594,706; run verify_p1.py; write result-r2.md/manifest.
